name: Tasogareru Sora, Dake ni Naku.
source:
Main character gets invited to a breathtaking school stage performance by childhood friend and becomes fascinated with the actor. Protagonist learns that this play is a joint project with another school, so he hurries to join his school theater club and participate in staging a new play.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角受到青梅竹马邀请，观看一场令人屏息的学校舞台表演，并被演员深深吸引。主角得知这出戏是与另一所学校合作的项目，于是赶紧加入本校戏剧社，参与新剧的制作。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
